messages:
anna.keller: Quick proposal for /v1/rescore semantics — goal is a clear, minimal contract that supports both rerank and rescoring use cases. Main points: (1) return both raw_model_score and normalized_score, (2) explicit candidate limit/overflow behavior, (3) model routing hint field, (4) telemetry labels for console rollouts. Posting a sample shape below.
sam.patel: TL;DR: why both scores? customers only want a single rank sometimes and billing needs units.
anna.keller: raw_model_score = model-specific logit-like value (opaque), normalized_score = [0..1] monotonic transform we compute server-side. Keeps downstream stable for UIs and A/B metrics while retaining raw for debugging/ensemble logic.
mike.harris: Need to be explicit about precision and type. Float64? We'll serialize as number but document we truncate to 6 decimal places to avoid huge diffs. Also: what about ties and stable sort key — add candidate_id as tiebreaker.
lucy.shih: Telemetry: include labels: model_id, model_variant, routing_reason (e.g. affinity|fallback|canary), candidate_count, input_token_count. Console needs them to show per-route health and quality regressions per rollout.
sam.patel: Example response envelope suggestion — please react if you dislike keys:

```json
{
  "request_id": "r_123",
  "model_id": "rescorer-v2",
  "scores_version": "v1",
  "items": [
    {"candidate_id": "c1", "raw_model_score": -12.34, "normalized_score": 0.87321},
    {"candidate_id": "c2", "raw_model_score": -13.5, "normalized_score": 0.72109}
  ],
  "meta": {"candidate_count": 2, "truncated": false}
}
```

sam.patel: Also add header `X-Scores-Version` and a `scores_version` field so older clients can detect changes.
anna.keller: Agree on header. Proposal for truncation behavior: if user supplies candidates > max_candidates (service config, default 200), we return top-N by raw_model_score and set `meta.truncated=true` and include `meta.original_count`.
mike.harris: Limits: default max_candidates=200, max_payload_tokens=12000. We should fail fast if total tokens > 50k with 413. For streaming we only stream the chosen top-K (K param).
lucy.shih: Quota/billing discussion: we should count 1 rescore_unit = sum(candidate_token_count + source_token_count) / 1000 and bill by units. That gives better cost signal than per-request. Need PM sign-off.
eva.chen: From product: console UX for rollouts — we need an automatic quality diff view when model changes. Also a clear fallback indicator when routing_reason != affinity. Users want to know if fallback caused lower scores.
anna.keller: For routing: add optional request.hints.model_affinity list; runtime will try affinity then fall back per policy (region->tier->fallback-model). We must surface `routing_chain` in meta (array of model_ids tried with reasons) so console can explain path.
sam.patel: Telemetry labels example: `labels: {"model_id":"rescorer-v2","routing_reason":"fallback","canary":true}`. Also log score distribution histograms on control plane for drift detection.
mike.harris: Compatibility: default normalized_score only added for new API version `scores_version=v1`. Legacy clients get raw_model_score only (we'll keep raw field name stable). Migration doc required.
lucy.shih: Ops: we should emit a lightweight per-request `quality_checksum` (hash of request+candidates) so we can map incoming predictions to downstream eval runs. Useful for regression alerts.
anna.keller: Action items: 1) RFC PR with response shape & limits, 2) console mock for rollout diffs (lucy), 3) billing/Quota proposal (mike + sam), 4) telemetry + alerting hooks (eva + lucy). Meeting to decide by EOD Friday?
deploy-bot: deploy-schedule: reminder — canary window open for rescorer-v2 on staging at 1782180000 (automated). :robot_face:
sam.patel: OK I'm ok with that timeline. I'll open RFC and include sample Kibana dashboard queries.
eva.chen: I'll draft the console mock and short product note for customers about new `scores_version` and fallback semantics.
anna.keller: great — thanks everyone. I'll file the RFC and tag reviewers. If anyone sees a hard blocker (billing/contract), comment on the PR before Thursday.
